sentences.text: By 1927 the company from Rochester, New York was a global power: more than twenty thousand employees, ten thousand of them at home, factories in England, France, Germany, Canada, and Australia, and **eighty-five percent of the American film market, eighty million rolls a year.** Two thirds of the release prints in American movie theatres were struck on Kodak stock, and more than half of everything Hollywood shot in the first place was Kodak negative.
